package_title: Component 4 Western Province Business Risk Dataset Package
provenance_warning: The generated CSV records in this package are simulated, not observed real businesses. File names intentionally use neutral task names, but data_origin and label_source fields explicitly disclose provenance. Do not describe these records as real SME records.

label_definitions.overall_risk_label: Rule-derived Low/Medium/High category from liquidity stress and relationship-risk controls; a simulator target, not historical failure/default.
label_definitions.liquidity_stress_label: Rule-derived from cash runway and debt-service ratio in financial snapshots.
label_definitions.relationship_risk_label: Rule-derived from supplier/customer concentration and disruption conditions.
label_definitions.growth_readiness_label: Proceed/Modify/Delay based on simulated post-action liquidity, debt service, capacity and investment pressure; mitigation variants have explicit intervention logic.

split_policy: Grouped by scenario_family_id. 70% of base businesses train, 15% validation, 15% test. Related snapshots, actions and paired mitigation variants stay in the same split.
limitations: No verified historical risk outcomes are available; labels are generated by transparent rules.
High performance on this dataset demonstrates learning simulator patterns, not real-world predictive accuracy.
Districts are assigned for Western Province scope, but distributions are not empirically calibrated to actual district populations.
Relationship edges are simulated and do not represent actual supplier/customer connections.
No links to the existing feasibility CSV or invoice entities are asserted.

real_dataset_candidate.name: World Bank Enterprise Survey 2025 - Sri Lanka
real_dataset_candidate.status: Official catalogue located; microdata is routed to the World Bank Enterprise Surveys portal. This package does not include the raw microdata because a verified, downloadable Western Province-only extract was not available in this workflow.
real_dataset_candidate.notes: National survey; filter only using documented region codes after obtaining data. Do not assume all 607 records are Western Province.
